refreshInterval.description: How often ESO refreshes the K8s Secret from ASM. Go duration string (e.g. "1h", "30m"). Defaults to "1h" if omitted — set lower in dev claims, higher in steady-state to reduce ASM API spend.

description.description: Free-form description attached to the ASM secret as a tag (Description=<value>). Surfaces in the AWS console for operators looking at the secret.

region.description: AWS region for the ASM secret. Defaults to us-east-1; override when the consuming workload lives elsewhere to avoid cross-region GetSecretValue.

asmSecretArn.description: ARN of the underlying ASM secret once created.
